name: markdown_source
description: real markdown input (rendered from a .md file), focusing on backslash handling (quiki#22)

tests.name: md_paragraph_backslash
tests.description: backslashes in paragraph text are preserved as-is

tests.name: md_paragraph_escaped_backslash
tests.description: markdown \\ renders as a single backslash

tests.name: md_fenced_code_backslash
tests.expected: a\b c\\d
tests.description: backslashes in fenced code block are not doubled

tests.name: md_fenced_code_braces
tests.expected: if (x) {  y }
tests.description: braces in fenced code block survive brace-escape

tests.name: md_html_block_backslash
tests.description: backslash in HTML block is not doubled
